mentions.name: Programmable Coda/Notion competitor
mentions.description: A considerably more powerful and programmable documents/workspace system intended to compete with Coda and Notion, in early development with no externally viewable progress yet.
mentions.problem: Frustration with the limitations of Coda (and to a lesser extent Notion) after extensive use.
mentions.source_excerpt: After working extensively with Coda (and much less with Notion), and becoming frustrated with its limitations, I decided to work on a considerably more powerful and programmable system to compete with both. No externally viewable progress so far, but soon ...
